requirements.title: Mandatory demographic & contact fields are enforced and persisted accurately on registration
Mobile, WhatsApp, Emergency phone numbers and Email addresses validate format, country rules and cross-field uniqueness
Patient names and titles preserve valid real-world punctuation, block invalid symbols/scripts and align with gender
Date of Birth and Age synchronize bidirectionally, support leap years and reject future or impossible human ages
PIN code forward/reverse lookup, state/district/city/area cascade and permanent address rules stay consistent
Payer Type, Payer and Sponsor enforce Self-Paid defaults and require explicit selection for Corporate and Insurance
Registration variants (New Born, International, Outside, Staff, Diagnostic) enforce variant-specific clinical and mandatory fields
Identity Type and Identity Number enforce conditional completeness and valid document attachment
Duplicate registrations and rapid double-submits are prevented without false success notifications
Global patient search locates records by UHID, Name and Mobile while safely escaping special regex characters
Existing patient updates track dirty state accurately, require remarks and enforce all mandatory and format validations
UI form transitions, type switches and field cascades reset stale values without premature validation errors

rules.text: Tenant onboarding prerequisites list client name, VPN access, database and report server details, tenant and facility names, a POC facility, IP address, lab-report migration mail access, firewall allowlisting, and doctor count and specialties.
Export has a confirmation dialog asking whether to export this tenant, with Yes and Cancel.
Logout has a confirmation dialog asking Sure to Logout?, with Yes and Cancel.
The sign-in screen offers a Forgot Password? link below Login.
Templates on the patient screen are grouped into tabs: All, Assessment, Scoring, Shift handover, Checklist and Monitoring, with a Search Templates box.

A workflow is built as Stage > Process > Task. A Stage has Select Role, New Process Name and Add; a process (for example SOAP) has its own Select Role and Create Task; stages and processes each have edit and delete buttons.
The stage builder has three page actions: Save Stage, Publish and Preview.
The Create Task dialog has New Task Name, a Multiple Tab toggle (off when opened), Select Role, Close and Submit.
Workflow preview shows the General Examination section with columns Skin colour, State of alertness, Activity, Range of spontaneous Movements, Posture, Muscle Tone and Actions, and a + button.

The search builder lets a user pick a DB object, tick its fields and group fields under an alias; an alias can hold more than one field (Age/Gender holds PATIENT_REGISTRATION_DB.age and PATIENT_REGISTRATION_DB.gender).
The Edit Target Name dialog has Enter New Name, a Select... dropdown, Cancel and OK.
The visit list shows a status legend: Waiting (yellow), Active (green), Closed (grey), and has Awaiting Review, Reset All Filters and Refresh buttons.
rules.source: IT Training.mp4 @ 08:31; Search Builder, Task, Count, Role.mp4 @ 10:51

openQuestions.text: Please provide transcripts or BA notes for all four videos; the extracted text is only a keyframe index and cannot establish spoken rules.
The new frames support 24 draft cases, but most expected outcomes are not visible and are marked assumed. Provide saved, published and error screens to confirm them.

Is EMR Setup scope limited to Work Flow, or does it include tenant onboarding, transfer, sign-in, template bar, stage builder, search builder and visit list counts? The videos cover several screens and page paths (/workflow-template-stages-array, /workflow-preview, /new-search, /patient, /visit-list).

openQuestions.text: Provide successful creation, update and reopen evidence, including required fields and expected persistence; no P0 creation or persistence expectation is established.
How should empty and whitespace-only mandatory values be handled? Provide messages, trimming rules and validation timing.
What are the minimum and maximum lengths, accepted formats, prefixes and character-handling rules for each editable field (including New Process Name, New Task Name and Enter New Name)?
openQuestions.source: Augastam Onboarding Process.mp4 @ 10:05; Augastam Template.mp4 @ 03:45; Search Builder, Task, Count, Role.mp4 @ 05:55

openQuestions.text: Which transfer fields are mandatory? For fields without an asterisk, required:false records no visible mandatory marker, not a confirmed optional business rule.
How do Environment, source and destination selections cascade? Are matching source and destination allowed, and what changes on mode or tab switching?
What are the outcomes of Import, Apply Setting, Create New Template and confirmed Export? Provide success/failure messages, overwrite rules and persistence evidence.
What should duplicate template names, repeated imports and double-clicked actions do? Are update remarks required? The template bar already shows near-duplicate names.
What should exact, partial, empty, no-match and special-character searches return? How do filters combine and reset?
openQuestions.source: Augastam Onboarding Process.mp4 @ 12:44; Augastam Template.mp4 @ 01:39; IT Training.mp4 @ 08:31

openQuestions.text: What do the header checkbox and Exported / Not Exported indicators mean, and how do individual workflow selections change?
Provide an unobscured workflow screen, allowed status transitions and the correct pagination range for eight records.
Confirm the result of Cancel and Yes for each confirmation; the frames do not capture the clicked choice or export completion.
Title-only frames at 00:00 and 15:38 show no application controls; the blank external page at 10:10 gives no HIS integration result.

Which application version is the target? Version 2.1.44 is shown in the template and visit list frames, version 2.0.45 in the search builder and Doctor visit list frames, and other labels on the onboarding home screens.

openQuestions.text: Which fields are mandatory in the stage builder and Create Task dialog (process name, task name, roles)? No asterisks are visible. What happens on Add or Submit with empty or whitespace-only names?
What does the Multiple Tab toggle change for a task?
What are the Select Role options, and how do roles set on Stage, Process and Task relate? Can a task role contradict the process or stage role, and which one wins?
What is the difference between Save Stage and Publish? Can an unpublished workflow be previewed, and can a published one still be edited? Are edit and delete allowed after publishing?
Is a delete confirmation shown for stages, processes, tasks and search aliases? None is captured.
openQuestions.source: Augastam Template.mp4 @ 03:45; Search Builder, Task, Count, Role.mp4 @ 05:55

openQuestions.text: How does a template get into the patient-screen template bar and which tab it appears under? The chip order differs between 01:39 and 13:24 with no visible reason.
What are the field types, allowed values and mandatory rules for the General Examination grid columns, and what does + add?
In the search builder, what does the Select... dropdown in Edit Target Name choose, what does Get Previous Saved Values restore, and how are aliases saved? No save button is visible in the frame.

The Count Configuration screen is open in a browser tab but never shown. Provide it: which chips can be configured, per role or per user, and how each count is calculated (for example, should Total equal the sum of other chips?).
Are visit list columns and the OP/IP/ER toggle role-based (Admin vs Doctor), or configured elsewhere? Is a From Date later than To Date blocked?
